beats.vo: Drinking to calm your nerves before your first time backfires.
beats.visual_intent: Ice melting in an empty glass, dark background.

beats.vo: It can dull what you feel, affect your body's response, and make it harder to read each other and talk clearly.
beats.visual_intent: Blurry out-of-focus street lights at night.

beats.vo: So don't use alcohol as your strategy for nerves. Show up clear-headed. That's what actually helps.
beats.visual_intent: Glass of water on a table, clean bright light.
